LanguageData.PMP.Stasis.Suspended: In stasis: contained entity cannot escape.
LanguageData.PMP.Stasis.AssignDesc: Select a downed or dormant entity, or a movable anomalous object. A hauler will bring it here. Holds one entity. Loss of power releases the captive; solar flares do not disable the field.
LanguageData.PMP.Stasis.ReleaseDesc: Release the original entity nearby. Its hostility and anomalous activity will resume.
LanguageData.PMP.Stasis.StudyDesc: Study through the field. Retains the entity's original research progress, unlocks and cooldown.
